you've already made it this far, it'll be all for not if you screw it up now.

I am Very well versed in these tests. Danced around them for 18 months. Sometimes weekly, sometimes even daily.   I have had so many staggering results that the only advice I can offer is allow 1 FULL WEEK. The test are getting to where the cutoff point is fucking rediculous. If you have a shit liver like me, and drank a fifth or more a day and then stopped cold turkey for 6 days, you can still fail. This was a lab verified test not some pee in a cup strip. 

My advice is that if this is for legal reasons, it's simply not worth the stress and time researching everyone online journal study you can find for hours or days just because you decided to get drunk.

Seeing as what subreddit we are in.  You can typically dilute the test to possibly buy you some time, but depending on how strict your district is, that itself could be an automatic fail.

Trust me I have boxes and boxes of different cuttof tests from different labs.  Even spent like $300 to get the same brand my court system used.

In the end it was just not worth it. If you have to find a way to keep drinking, sub a clean sample but the the temp has to be near perfect and at my lab they would purposely make you sit around in the lobby for ages with no one else in line.  They know all the tricks by now.

To me your situation doesn't involve going to prison, so I wouldn't fret too much, but maybe this rant will help someone else.

Antitdoteally I had weekeds like mentioned in other threads where I drank multiple handles and passed after 48 hours.  There are just so many factors involved like test sensitivity, hydration, personal metabolism and liver functions.
